snippet.title: Meteor Raiders // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3212940/Meteor_Raiders

Space Miner is a shmup with roguelike elements and weapon customization. Destroy asteroids, collect different minerals to improve your ship, and discover new places on the galaxy!

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer: Julio Maass
📚 Publisher: Julio Maass
📅 Release Date: Coming Soon to Early Access
🎯 Genre: Action, Casual, Indie, Early Access
